pinning.reason: Tongue ships its 2 MB weights inside the npm package, so the host prepares and fetches nothing: this asset set has no assets and no groups by design. The revision is the npm package version the lock already declares as model.revision, restated so a preparation plan has an identity. A zero-asset preparation records that nothing was downloaded rather than claiming bytes that were never fetched; readiness can then be recorded and the deployment enabled.

qualification.processor: the package's own normalization (whitespace/case folding per tongue_meta.json)

tongue-bundled.note: Tongue ships its 2 MB weights inside the npm package, so there is no separately downloaded asset to lock. The asset array is empty by design, not by omission: an empty array here asserts that preparation fetches nothing. The qualification record above is REAL: artifactSha is the SHA-256 of the shipped dist/tongue_int8.bin the extension stats at inspection time, and the qualification test re-computes it and runs real inference through the installed package.
